kinds.a: fabric softener · dryer sheets · dryer balls
kinds.d: Product added at the rinse or in the dryer to soften, reduce static and scent fabrics.

kinds.a: pre-wash spray · oxygen bleach · stain bar · colour catcher
kinds.d: Product that lifts stains or stray dye from textiles before or during washing.

kinds.a: scent beads · in-wash booster · fabric refresher spray
kinds.d: Beads added to the wash, or a spray used on dry fabrics, to add scent or remove odours.

kinds.a: crease releaser · spray starch · ironing water
kinds.d: Spray that relaxes creases, stiffens fabric or eases steam ironing.

kinds.a: lint roller · fabric shaver · bobble remover · clothes brush
kinds.d: Roller, brush or powered shaver that removes lint, fluff, hair and pilling from fabric.

notes: Seven old kinds became five. Dryer sheets (k82) dissolved into Fabric conditioner as a type alongside liquid softener and wool dryer balls; its Food Lion SKU URL dropped in favour of the existing M&S category page. Scent booster (k83) and Fabric freshener (k84) merged into one kind; the freshener's duplicate M&S URL dropped, Downy page kept. Stain remover gained its planned types (pre-wash spray, oxygen bleach, stain bar, colour-run remover, colour catcher); OxiClean spray kept as the only model. Ironing spray and Lint remover kept with attribute variants moved into t. All existing models retained (none exceeded the ≤12 cap). Brand ranges for Comfort, Lenor, Downy, Bounce, Vanish and OxiClean added only because the shelf brief named them as market leaders; parent-company attributions are from general knowledge and should be verified against the brand register, not treated as new register entries. No archetypes or new kinds added.
